title: Plasmid DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Shuning Guo

Discard the filtrate and reuse collection tube.
Let sit at room temperature for 1 minute.

steps.title: Inoculate and Incubate Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a culture of 1-5 mL LB medium containing the appropriate selective antibiotic using a single colony from a freshly streaked selective plate.

substeps.instruction: Use a 10-20 mL culture tube or a flask with a volume at least 4 times the culture volume.
Incubate for ~12-16 hours at 37°C with vigorous shaking (~300 rpm).
Note: Use of an endA negative strain of E. coli (e.g., DH5a® or JM109®) is strongly recommended.

steps.title: Harvest Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 10,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Decant or aspirate and discard the culture media.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Solution I/RNase A (RNase A must be added to Solution I before use) to the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Vortex or pipet up and down to mix thoroughly until the cell pellet is completely resuspended.

steps.title: Transfer Suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the resuspension into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Solution II to the tube.

substeps.instruction: Invert and gently rotate the tube several times to obtain a clear lysate.
Do not allow the lysis reaction to proceed for more than 5 minutes.
Avoid vigorous mixing to prevent shearing chromosomal DNA.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Solution III and immediately invert several times until a flocculent white precipitate forms.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the solution is mixed thoroughly and immediately to avoid localized precipitation.

steps.title: Separate Precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≥13,000 x g, specifically 15,000 x g) for 10 minutes at room temperature to form a compact white pellet.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Mini Column
steps.instruction: Insert a HiBind® DNA Mini Column into a 2 mL Collection Tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the cleared supernatant from the previous step into the HiBind® DNA Mini Column, ensuring no cellular debris or pellet is transferred.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (15,000 x g) for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash Column with HBC Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL HBC Buffer (which must be diluted with isopropanol before use) to the column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (15,000 x g) for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash Column with DNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL DNA Wash Buffer to the column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (15,000 x g) for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Dry Column Matrix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty HiBind® DNA Mini Column for 2 minutes at maximum speed to dry the matrix.

steps.title: Prepare for Elution
steps.instruction: Transfer the HiBind® DNA Mini Column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 30-100 μL Elution Buffer or sterile deionized water (pH ~8.5) directly to the center of the column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (15,000 x g) for 1 minute at room temperature to recover approximately 70% of bound DNA.

steps.title: Perform Optional Second Elution
steps.instruction: To recover residual DNA, repeat the elution process.

substeps.instruction: Suck out the solution from the tube and re-add it to the center of the column membrane.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Analyze and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Test the concentration and purity of the DNA using NanoDrop.
